entities.summary: The Octagon will be the new headquarters for the Egyptian Ministry of Defense, being a part of a much larger initiative of moving all governmental offices to the New Capital, Egypt. The establishment of the new headquarters aims to be the largest in the Middle East and the world, located in Egypt’s new capital.
